title: Which clicks were available to the noon prediction?
scope: Original ten-click example. Each numbered click keeps its identity; noon is the prediction boundary, midnight the later batch snapshot.

steps.label: Historical boundary
steps.description: The noon record can use only the four events already logged.
cards: c5 c6 c7 c8 c9 c10

steps.label: Point-in-time join
steps.description: Copy only available evidence into the noon feature. Future events remain excluded.
cards: c5 c6 c7 c8 c9 c10

steps.label: Midnight aggregation
steps.description: The batch job can legitimately aggregate all ten clicks at midnight; its timestamp differs from the prediction moment.

steps.label: Reject the future join
steps.description: Joining midnight total 10 to noon would include c5–c10. Keep the historical feature at 4; timestamp alignment prevents this specific leakage.
